subject: RMA process for cel file of v3

messages.author: c264a3d003b6a84f
messages.subject: RMA process for cel file of v3
parts:
Hi,

I need to perform the RMA analysis on some exon array cel files of v3
(ASCII) using aroma. Error occurs in rmabackground correction:

Error in list("source("mainBRCA.R")" = <environment>,
"eval.with.vis(ei, envir)" = <environment>, :

[2007-07-23 11:57:26] Exception: Cannot create CEL file of version
4(probeData/BRCA,RBC/HuEx-1_0-st-v2/BR_BT20_14_v1_WT.cel). Template
CEL file has version 3: rawData/BRCA/HuEx-1_0-st-v2/
BR_BT20_14_v1_WT.cel

Is there any solution to this problem?

Thanks,

Ju

messages.author: 9dda904b2c7a149c
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] RMA process for cel file of v3
parts:
Hi Ju,

I would strongly recommend converting your CEL files to binary before you begin the analysis as that will speed things up enormously, and use less memory.  See the documentation for convertCel(), and if you do a search for "convert" from the group page you will get a few hits which will give you more info on how to proceed.

Cheers,

Ken
